summary: Finished slice 2 (docs and version): README toggle example and feature bullet; documentation/api.md (toggleOptions row and ToggleOptions section), features.md (On/Off Toggle Mode), examples.md (Recipe 6), configuration.md (Toggle Defaults), development.md (Toggle Mode Internals), breaking-changes.md (1.6.0 additive note); docs/features/zest-button-toggle/BRS.md; version bumped to 1.6.0 in package.json and package-lock.json. Added R8 tests. Build succeeds and the full suite passes (15 suites, 163 tests).

tests.name: R8: the API page documents every ToggleOptions prop and the README shows a toggle example
R8: the documented examples type-check against the exported types and render
R1: an empty toggleOptions object enables toggle mode, off by default
R2: self-managed toggle starts off, flips per click and reports each value
R3: the check mark and pressed look show only when on, and the check is hidden from screen readers
R4: checkPosition 'end' places the check after the label
R5: it stays a button (no switch role) that reports pressed
R6: the on state has its own hover and active rules and uses rem, not px
R7: with confirmOptions the first click does not flip, the confirming click flips once
R9: toggle mode adds no listeners or timers that survive unmount
